sources_considered.why: Readable secondary discussion of the funding-status statistic and its limits. It is context, not proof of customer profitability.
The filing describes possible customer financing risk but does not quantify customers meeting both claimed conditions.
Search located the funding-status statistic, but read_page returned HTTP 403.
The retrieved page did not expose the relevant October funding-status analysis.

receipt.public_excerpt: Venture backing alone cannot establish dependence on the next funding round.

evidence_items.explanation: The article distinguishes funding status among heavy AI spenders from evidence about their finances. It does not measure the proportion of Anthropic customers that are loss-making and unable to sustain operations.

unresolved_gaps: No representative customer count linked to profitability and financing dependence was located.
The heavy-spender sample is not the same population as Anthropic's business customers.
No common loss measure or evidence of sustained financing necessity was available for the customer population.
